description: A comparator and a two-way signal switch, with the comparator's result normalled to the switch's control

params.text: Sets the voltage a comparator input falls back to when nothing is patched into it, over -5V to 5V

inputs.text: One of the two voltages being compared, the one that must be the greater for the comparator to go high; unpatched it reads the voltage knob
One of the two voltages being compared, the one that must be the lower for the comparator to go high; unpatched it reads the voltage knob
Chooses which switch input reaches the output: above 0V passes switch B, at or below 0V passes switch A, which is the reverse of the maker's manual. Unpatched it reads the comparator output
One of the two signals the switch chooses between, passed while the control is at or below 0V; unpatched it reads the comparator A input
One of the two signals the switch chooses between, passed while the control is above 0V; unpatched it reads the comparator B input

outputs.text: Whichever of the two switch inputs the control has picked
5V while comparator A is above comparator B, and 0V otherwise

notes: The two lamps between the switch inputs and the switch control are crossed: the lamp on the A side lights while the B input is the one reaching the output.
The maker's manual says a control voltage above 0V passes switch A; the module passes switch B.
